home.title: Card Surveys
home.lead: Surveys in which respondents arrange cards: they order them, sort them into rows or piles, connect them with arrows or tap them in sequence. Each arrangement is stored as the set of statements it makes about pairs of cards.
home.t_boards: Six boards: rows, rows with an aside region, arrows, piles, a plane and pairwise questions.
home.t_sob: Subjective Order Blocks: small blocks of items sorted into levels, with a side bin for items that stand in no order.
home.t_tap: Tap-order blocks: the cards of a block are tapped in order, with an optional anchor card that gives every order an absolute reference.
home.t_experiment: Surveys with random assignment to versions of a material, a free-choice arm, follow-up questions and a closing explanation.
home.who_text: Accounts are open to members of the Jagiellonian University with an address in uj.edu.pl, student.uj.edu.pl or doctoral.uj.edu.pl. Respondents need no account.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: Respondents answer without an account. Each response receives a random identifier. The system stores no network address and no description of the browser.
privacy.p2: A respondent can withdraw at any time. A withdrawal deletes every answer and arrangement of the response; only the information that a response was withdrawn remains.
privacy.p3: The system records how long each screen was open, so that researchers can check the burden of a survey. These times are not linked to anyone's identity.
privacy.p4: Researcher accounts store an e-mail address and a password hash. The researcher responsible for a survey states its purpose, legal basis and retention period in the survey's consent text.

demo.title: Demonstrations
demo.lead: Every technique on a short example. Arrangements made here are not stored.
demo.nothing_stored: The demonstrations store nothing. The studio offers each technique as a ready survey to copy.
demo.count: On {n} cards this format can record {count} different arrangements; {total} consistent orders exist on {n} cards.
demo.board_tier_aside: Tier board with an aside region
demo.does_tier: puts each card in a row; a lower row comes first
demo.does_tier_aside: puts each card in a row or sets it aside
demo.does_arrow: draws arrows between cards; arrows that follow appear dashed
demo.does_plane: places each card at a point of a plane
demo.does_pairs: answers every pair on its own: before, after, unrelated or cannot decide
demo.does_sob: sorts the items of each small block into levels or into the side bin
demo.does_tap: taps the cards of each block in order, the anchor card included
demo.records_tier: Orders with ties and at most as many levels as rows; two cards in one row are recorded as unordered.
demo.records_tier_aside: As the tier board, and a card set aside stands in no relation to any card.
demo.records_arrow: Every consistent order, including cards that stand apart; the board refuses circles.
demo.records_pile: Which cards belong together (a partition into groups).
demo.records_plane: Orders that a plane can draw; on five or fewer cards every consistent order.
demo.records_pairs: Every pattern of answers; whether the answers are consistent is checked afterwards, and “cannot decide” leaves the pair unobserved.
demo.records_sob: For every pair of items in a block: one before the other, or no order. Pooled over a balanced design, every pair is observed the same number of times.
demo.records_tap: A full order of every block; with the anchor card, also whether each item stands above or below the reference.
demo.sob_design: Blocks follow a balanced incomplete block design: every item appears equally often, and every pair of items shares a block equally often.
demo.tap_anchor: The anchor card turns relative orders into absolute statements: an item tapped after “nothing / no one” is below the threshold of the criterion.
demo.designs_text: v items, blocks of k, every pair together in λ blocks, every item in r blocks, b blocks in all.

module_help.consent: The first screen: information about the study and consent. Declining ends the survey without storing anything.
module_help.form: Questions with answer options or free answers. A question can depend on an earlier answer.
module_help.board: One board with up to eight cards.
module_help.sob_blocks: Items in blocks from a balanced design; each block is sorted into levels and a side bin.
module_help.tap_blocks: Items in blocks from a balanced design; each block is tapped in order, with an optional anchor card, a question after each block, repeated and attention blocks. Variants choose a different item set by an earlier answer.
module_help.randomizer: Assigns an arm by permuted blocks within strata of earlier answers; no screen.
module_help.stimulus: Text shown according to the assigned arm and, optionally, an earlier answer.
module_help.choice: The respondent chooses one material and then sees it.
module_help.debrief: The closing explanation of the study, with an offer to withdraw.
